name: Benaiah
summary: A mighty man of David from Kabzeel, set over the Cherethites and the Pelethites. He stood with Solomon and became captain over the whole army.

key_moments.title: Kills a Lion in a Pit
key_moments.description: Benaiah killed two lionlike men of Moab, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion. He also killed an Egyptian with the Egyptian's own spear.

key_moments.title: Bringing Solomon to Gihon
key_moments.description: Benaiah answered King David with an amen. With Zadok and Nathan he brought Solomon down to Gihon to be anointed king.

key_moments.title: Puts Joab to Death
key_moments.description: At Solomon's command Benaiah put Joab to death at the altar of the LORD. Solomon then set Benaiah over the army in Joab's place.
